title: Prime deliveries delayed across multiple shipments
situation: 51 angry customers, including 4 VIPs and 7,990 SAR at risk, are facing delayed shipments and unhelpful support responses.
hypothesis: System scheduling error causing widespread delivery delays

params.reply_en: We see your Prime delivery is late. We are working with logistics to get your parcel to you immediately and have added 20 SAR credit to your account.
params.reply_ar: نحن ندرك تأخر طلبك برايم. نعمل مع شركاء الشراكة لتوصيل شحنتك فوراً، وتمت إضافة رصيد بقيمة 20 ريالاً إلى حسابك.

actions.why: Acknowledge the delay, reassure customers, and issue goodwill credit.
Compensate affected customers for broken delivery promises.

actions.title: Prime Delivery Delays Handling
actions.answer_en: Prime deliveries experiencing system scheduling delays are compensated with 20 SAR credit and expedited to the customer.
actions.answer_ar: يتم تعويض تأخيرات توصيل برايم الناتجة عن خطأ في النظام برصيد 20 ريالاً وتسريع وصول الشحنة.

reply_en: We see your Prime delivery is late. We are working with logistics to get your parcel to you immediately and have added 20 SAR credit to your account.

reply_other.fr: Nous constatons que votre livraison Prime est en retard. Nous travaillons avec la logistique pour vous acheminer votre colis immédiatement et avons ajouté 20 SAR de crédit sur votre compte.
reply_other.es: Vemos que tu entrega Prime está retrasada. Estamos trabajando con logística para entregarte tu paquete de inmediato y hemos añadido 20 SAR de crédito a tu cuenta.
reply_other.de: Wir sehen, dass Ihre Prime-Lieferung verspätet ist. Wir arbeiten mit der Logistik zusammen, um Ihnen Ihr Paket umgehend zuzustellen, und haben Ihrem Konto 20 SAR Gutschrift hinzugefügt.

alternatives.why: Local delivery partners may be understaffed.
Packages stuck at regional hubs causing cascading delays.
